**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The RENEWAL rule is effectively inapplicable to this agreement. Section 12.1.1 creates a single, self-limiting Term — running from the Effective Date until expiry of the last Royalty Term for the last Licensed Product, or until the License Option Period lapses without AbbVie exercising the License Option. There is no evergreen or auto-renewal mechanic: searches for "renew", "automatically", "extend the Term", "successive" and multi-year renewal patterns returned no operative renewal provision, and there is no renewal price-uplift language.

Direction check confirms the structure favours us as customer:
- We need give no non-renewal notice to avoid an unwanted extension, so there is no notice window to shorten.
- Any extension would require a mutual written amendment, which aligns with the playbook's preferred position (renewal only by mutual written agreement).
- On expiry under clause (a), Section 12.1.2 converts our Section 5.1.3 grants to non-exclusive, fully-paid, royalty-free and irrevocable — expiry improves our position rather than degrading it.

No edit is warranted; flagging this would add friction with no commercial benefit.
